metadata.chapter_subtitle: How snow gains and loses energy—the foundation of melt modelling

inventory.summary: The chapter was technically strong but needed a learner-facing bridge into the snow energy budget before the full flux equation.
issues: The chapter lacked the standard onboarding block.
The opening moved quickly from narrative context to the full energy-balance equation.
The melt-threshold idea needed clearer framing for first-time readers.

rewrite.summary: Completed a full editorial pass that added onboarding and clarified the difference between energy gain and actual meltwater production.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start block.
Clarified that energy accumulation precedes meltwater release.
Smoothed the transition into the energy-budget notation.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now introduces the snow energy budget more gently while preserving the full technical structure.

repair.summary: The pacing issue was repaired during the editorial pass.
actions_taken: Clarified the relation between warming the pack and producing melt.
Improved the transition into the energy-flux notation.

design_review.summary: The chapter's flux breakdown and visual structure now do more interpretive work for the reader.
improvements_made: Improved interpretive support around the surface energy-balance terms.
